description: You are using Aerobridge, an open-source drone/UAV fleet management system. Your task is to register a new aircraft in the Aerobridge registry. Log in to the admin panel at http://localhost:8000/admin/ using username 'admin' and password 'adminpass123'. In the Registry section, scroll down to find 'Aircrafts' and click '+ Add'. Fill in these required fields: (1) Name: 'Phoenix Mk3', (2) Operator: select any available option from the dropdown (e.g. 'DIY Build your Aerial Robots Inc.'), (3) Manufacturer: select any available option (e.g. 'Nile Robotics'), (4) Flight controller id: enter 'PHXFC2024001' (alphanumeric only, no special characters), (5) Status: leave as 'Active' (default), (6) Final assembly: select the one available option from the dropdown (exactly one 'Complete' assembly is prepared for this task). Click Save to register the aircraft. Do not log out after saving.
